name: Deemii Winter Gloves Men Women Made with 3M Thinsulate, Lightweight Thermal Warm Gloves for Cold Weather with Touch Screen Fingers, Water Resistant Running...
blurb:
Stay Warm & Connected This Winter

The Deemii Winter Gloves combine premium warmth with everyday practicality. Featuring 3M Thinsulate insulation, they keep your hands toasty at temperatures as low as 23°F while staying lightweight and flexible. 

The touchscreen-enabled thumb and index fingers let you text, navigate, or answer calls without removing your gloves — no more freezing fingers.

Designed for versatility, these gloves excel at running, cycling, hiking, driving, or just daily commutes. Customers consistently praise their comfort, excellent grip with silicone stripes, and exceptional value. Water-resistant and wind-resistant, they're built to handle changing winter weather.
